title: cakile maritima var. aequalis
intro: Cakile maritima var. aequalis, commonly known as sea rocket, is a plant species within the Brassicaceae family. It is known for its medicinal and edible properties. The plant is rich in vitamins and minerals, and it has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of sea rocket include glucosinolates, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, contributing to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and improving wound healing.
